description: IEC 61260 one-third-octave band definitions for Holten Line-C vibration spectral analysis.
notes: Use fc_exact_hz / fl_hz / fu_hz for all numerical computations.
nominal_hz values are labels only — do not use for edge calculations.
The 1 Hz band (k=-30) extends below 1 Hz (fl ≈ 0.891 Hz).
The 100 Hz band (k=-10) extends above 100 Hz (fu ≈ 112.2 Hz).
